title: base_manifest.md
content:
# Manifest

## Root

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `Universal_NPC_Voice_Lab.html` | Single-file voice program with inline CSS/JS, NPC model registry, emotion regulator, sliders, export, browser TTS fallback, and locked backend hook. |

## Docs

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/README.md` | Usage and implementation notes. |
| `docs/MANIFEST.md` | This package inventory. |
| `docs/VOICE_MODEL_SELECTION.md` | The selected single voice-model per NPC. |
| `docs/UNUSED_CODE_AUDIT.md` | Uploaded-source audit and exclusion notes. |
| `docs/LICENSES_AUDIT.md` | License status of inspected uploads. |

## No external runtime dependencies

The program does not require npm, Python, model downloads, or external static assets. It uses browser-native Web Speech APIs and an optional backend call.
